notes.text:
This update for libxml2 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-0989: Fixed call stack exhaustion leading to application crash
  due to RelaxNG parser not limiting the recursion depth when
  resolving `<include>` directives (bsc#1256805).

notes.text: A flaw was identified in the RelaxNG parser of libxml2 related to how external schema inclusions are handled. The parser does not enforce a limit on inclusion depth when resolving nested <include> directives. Specially crafted or overly complex schemas can cause excessive recursion during parsing. This may lead to stack exhaustion and application crashes, creating a denial-of-service risk.
